extracted.intended_audience: mintmasters, metalworkers, assayers and craftsmen producing coinage and metal alloys (historical/manual audience)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance for preparing metal alloys and coinage: how to compute amounts of fine metal and base metal to add, how to perform successive remelts (fonditure), test fineness, and compute resulting value/weights for coins or commercial exchanges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Determine alloy composition from quantities of fine metal
rubrics_metrics.description: Prima prendi esempio quando bisogna aggiunger rame. Vedi quanto argento fino è in tutto la lega e quanti parti confolato; prima vedi quante parti argento fino e in tutte quelle parti èo.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute how much fine silver (argento fino) you have in total and use multiplication/division rules to determine how much base metal (rame, bronzo) to add so that the resulting alloy has the desired fineness. Work by parts: multiply weights by fineness fractions, sum fine portions, divide by total weight to find resulting fineness. Follow the numeric examples provided (e.g., sequences of 'via', 'fa', numeric multipliers) to carry out the arithmetic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use sequential fonditure (remelting) and batch mixing
rubrics_metrics.description: Fonditure: fai le fonditure in più curtè monete con aggiungimento di rame o d'argento; fondi tutto quello e cumma insieme; le fonditure in fondo fanno ... e quelle rimontero.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare alloys by successive remelts in batches: melt partial quantities ('fonditure'), combine melts ('giongnino infiemi'), then remelt as needed to homogenize. Plan batch sizes and sequence (first, second, etc.), track what fraction of each batch goes into the next, and repeat until alloy uniformity and target fineness are achieved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compute resulting fineness by weighted averaging
rubrics_metrics.description: Quando confolari insieme più fonditure o leghe, vedi che la lega torna effettivamente a quella finitura protestata: le fonditure insieme fanno X e quelle rimanenti danno Y; la regola generale è di moltiplicare il peso di ciascuna per la sua finura e dividere per il peso totale.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To find the fineness of a mixture, multiply each component's fineness by its weight, add the products, and divide by total weight (weighted average). Use this method when combining pure metal with alloys or different alloys together. The text demonstrates this with concrete numeric examples (summing fine parts across 'fonditure').

rubrics_metrics.name: Adjust fineness by adding base metal (e.g., copper) or fine metal
rubrics_metrics.description: Per ridurre o alzare la fincita della lega aggiungi rame o argento fino secondo le quantità calcolate: voglio aggiungere rame o argento; dire quanto ne conviene aggiungere per arrivare alla lega desiderata.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calculate the precise amount of base metal to add to obtain a lower fineness or the amount of fine metal to add for a higher fineness. Follow proportional arithmetic: determine fine metal present, choose desired fineness, solve for added material using cross-multiplication. The manual warns that sometimes it is impossible to reach a target without adding larger components ('non potrai mai fare senza aggiunzione o fare più alto del bisogno').

rubrics_metrics.name: Test and verify fineness by reheating samples and noting returns
rubrics_metrics.description: Fai provette: metti in margine sempre i calcoli; prendi modo del confolare; vedi la fumo/fuma e quante parti rimarranno; fai fondere e vedi quel che ritorna.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: During operations, take small test samples, heat to observe how much fine metal returns (e.g., 'quello che ne vi rira fira la finec[a]'), and record margins. Use repeated reheating and assaying of these samples to verify the alloy's fineness before proceeding to full production.

rubrics_metrics.name: Divide alloy into major and minor portions with proportional assignment
rubrics_metrics.description: Ponilo cotto el maggiore; da un lato e ponilo cotto el menore: vedi qui come bisogna porre le differentie e le parti; le maggiori da un canto, le minori dall'altro.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When portioning an alloy into pieces (for coins, ingots, or further processing), assign larger and smaller parts deliberately and keep their proportions consistent. Use the described order to arrange parts so subsequent arithmetic and melting steps preserve intended ratios.

rubrics_metrics.name: When combining multiple alloys, proceed stepwise pairing and recomputation
rubrics_metrics.description: Quando confolari varie fonditure fai prima le operazioni tra due insiemi, poi rimetti insieme e ricalcola; parti, fai fonditure, poi le metti infiemi e ridi la regola per trovare la lega.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do pairwise combining of alloys then recompute fineness iteratively: combine two batches, compute resulting fineness by weighted average, then combine that result with the next batch, repeating until all are combined. Keep track of intermediate totals (weights and fine content).

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow prescribed numeric sequences for repeated operations (via/fa counts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Le istruzioni usano sequenze come 'via.25.fa.1 75', '5.via.4p.fa.200' e simili per organizzare quante fonditure e come partizionare; tali 'via' e 'fa' indicano passi e moltiplicazioni da seguire.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Execute the specific iterative multiplication/division steps recommended (the 'via'/'fa' sequences) to partition, remelt, and recombine metals in the proper proportions. These numeric recipes provide step counts and multiplication factors to reach common coinage proportions; follow them for reproducible outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account for impossibility when component granularity is insufficient
rubrics_metrics.description: Se la tua lega manca di certe quantità non potrai fare alcune operazioni: 'non e possibile senza aiuto o qualcu[no] che sia maggiore' — some fineness targets cannot be reached from given parts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before attempting to reach a target fineness, check whether available quantities and granularity allow achieving it solely by mixing existing pieces; if not, external addition (more fine metal or base metal) is required. The manual cautions about impossible targets and signals when additional help is needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use denomination and value conversion rules for valuation of alloyed coins
rubrics_metrics.description: Si danno regole per convertire valori, es.: 'puoi legare valute a una valuta come a dir ...', 'val.24 e cannella ...' — convert between units/currencies according to fineness and weight.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When producing coinage, calculate monetary value by converting weights and fineness into denominations. Use conversion factors and tables given (weights per coin, value per fineness unit) to find the coin's face or intrinsic value when alloyed; apply consistent unit conversions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record calculations and marginal annotations for traceability
rubrics_metrics.description: Metti in margine sempre i calcoli e le quantità per facilitare il controllo: 'metti in margine sempre', 'fai conto prima e poi scrivi' appears throughout the text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep margin notes of each arithmetic step, record amounts added at each fonditura, and annotate batches so later steps and verifications can be traced. This prevents errors during repeated remelting and recombination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partition alloying work into prescribed component procedures to make standard coins
rubrics_metrics.description: Per fare bolcone, quattrini o altre monete a una lega determinata, segui l'ordine: vedere la lega che vuoi fare, confolare, fondere, dividere e tornare alla lega secondo la regola data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To produce a standard coin type, follow the full procedure: determine desired alloy, calculate amounts to mix, perform fonditure batches, homogenize by remelting, divide into blanks (bolzone, quattrini), and assail via tests. The manual provides patterns specific to types of coins and standard leghe (e.g., 'lega de 7', 'lega de 9')—use those templates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compute capital, gains, and distribution across voyages with proportional arithmetic
rubrics_metrics.description: Nelle parti finali si danno regole per i guadagni e capitale su più viaggi: 'fa due viaggi al primo guadagno ... parti ... multiplica ... la ragion del primo ...' e usare frazioni, multipli e radici per ricondurre capitale e guadagni.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For commercial accounting (voyages/trade), partition gains proportionally to capital and number of trips: use multiplication and fraction rules to determine how much capital returns and how gains are shared. For more complex cases, use square/square-root or quadratic-like recomputation (e.g., compare squares of gains to reconcile capital/gains as illustrated). Follow the stepwise algebraic recipes given.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use squares/quadratic-like methods for reconciling capital and compound gains
rubrics_metrics.description: Per casi di guadagni successivi si ricorre a 'quadrati', 'quadri', 'la radice del tuo capitale al secondo guadagno ...' e operazioni con quadrati per trovare la parte di capitale o guadagno.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When gains compound over multiple periods/trips and simple proportional splitting doesn't suffice, apply the described procedure using squares and manipulations of quadratic expressions (multiply, add squares of parts, take roots) to deduce original capital or individual gains. The manual sketches procedures for these algebraic reconciliations.
